content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Chesapeake

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a degree plus years of directed project work, or equivalent experience. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend interactive sessions on your schedule—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world frameworks and case studies across five days of structured, PMI-approved instruction.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee at application. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on forms and deadlines to keep your timeline on track.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and live review sessions—to build confidence. Register with Pearson VUE and sit for the computer-based exam at your chosen testing center or approved remote location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) across a standard three-year renewal cycle by taking courses, volunteering, or contributing to the profession. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training to support continuous learning and recertification.
